I've recently moved to Las Vegas and the idea of doing a garden in my yard seems like too much work in the heat. Would an indoor hydroponic garden work? Or would it even work outside in the heat? What are some beginners tips you are willing to share?
Could aHydroponic Garden in Vegas Work?
Got ac? If so then yes, you can grow anywhere as long as you can keep the temps reasonable and supple the light, water and nutrients.
Thank you. I'm excited to start trying!

I've been growing indoors in Vegas for years. :D

The air is a little dry but as long as you keep the temps inside stable and within your plants desired range, you should be just fine.

Hydroponics is awesome and can be very simple and effective. Choose a basement or internal / northerly exposed room for your indoor garden. Air conditioning in Texas will be invaluable too. Try a 50/50 blend of coco coir potting mix and perlite in fabric pots on a 4 x 4' ebb and flow table. Choose a 30 - 50 gallon reservoir with a lid. Invest in a TDS meter and test your water. If it is over 200 ppms you should consider water purification. Most mesophile plants can tolerate a wide range of air temperature, as long as the roots are kept cool - 66 - 68F. Larger nutrient tanks are less prone to pH and temperature fluctuations. Look for a YouTube channel called "Just4Growers" - I run it and I'm happy to help if and where I can. Good luck!
